title: SWF publish: ScriptLimits tag malformed — Ruffle fails to read it, AS2 initialization broken
description:
After fixing 0903 (black screen), the Test Movie dialog now shows the game title screen visually. However, the game AS2 is completely non-functional. Found in console (raw, before CSS-format filtering):

  ERROR core/src/tag_utils.rs:77 Error running definition tag: ScriptLimits, got Couldn't read SWF: failed to fill whole buffer
  ERROR core/src/tag_utils.rs:77 Error running definition tag: ScriptLimits, got Couldn't read SWF: failed to fill whole buffer

This error appears TWICE — once per Ruffle instance (the Test Movie dialog opens two parallel Ruffle players). The ScriptLimits SWF tag (tag type 65) contains two UI16 fields: max recursion depth and script timeout. Ruffle's error 'failed to fill whole buffer' means the tag's declared body length is shorter than what Ruffle tries to read — the tag is being emitted with too few bytes.

Impact:
- After loading, the Ruffle player shows the title screen content (Play button, hint text visible) but NO AS2 interaction works
- Keyboard keys (Space, Enter, arrow keys) produce no reaction
- Mouse clicks on the Play button produce no reaction even after dismissing the unmute overlay
- No AS2 trace() output at all — entire script execution layer is likely broken

Observed in QA run 11 (2026-06-10):
- Console at 18546ms and 18578ms: ERROR ScriptLimits 'failed to fill whole buffer'
- Shadow DOM: ruffle-player focused, unmute overlay dismissed, focus confirmed
- Canvas: Ruffle is rendering (1100x800 WebGL canvas, two SWF blobs loaded cleanly)
- Ruffle player is focused (document.activeElement === ruffle-player)
- No new console entries after any interaction (click, Space, Enter)

Expected: ScriptLimits tag should encode as exactly 4 bytes (2× UI16). Check the SWF compiler's ScriptLimits emission for off-by-one or wrong tag length declaration.
